name: demon
description: a Demon, the big infernal demon of Fall from Heaven (Chaos Marauders, Balors): a muscular bare red-skinned demon with two curved bone-coloured horns, pointed ears, yellow eyes and a fanged jaw, large dark red bat wings spread on both sides, a barbed arrow-tipped tail curling at the screen-left, a black loincloth on a black belt with gold studs, spiked black wristbands, black cloven hooves, and a big jagged black serrated blade with dull red edges held upright in its LEFT hand
hands: the jagged black blade stays in its left hand on the screen-right side and its right hand is an empty clawed fist on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, wings flare, the jagged black blade is lifted up over the head with its tip pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the jagged blade cocked behind the horned head with the blade hanging down behind the shoulders, clawed right fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front hoof steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the jagged black blade is level, pointing to the lower-right, wings spread wide
strike.4: contact: blade arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the jagged black blade slashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, clawed right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the jagged blade carries on down until its tip nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, wings and tail trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front hoof pulls back halfway, the jagged blade lifts back toward the upright ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; horned head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, wings jerk open, both arms jerk outward (clawed right fist flung out to the left, blade arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the jagged blade dipping, clawed fist still held out, wings half spread

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near hoof, body thrown back, blade arm flung up, clawed right arm drooping, wings sagging
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, horned head droops, the jagged blade lowering, wings drooping
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the jagged blade's tip resting on the ground, clawed arm hanging, wing tips touching the ground
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the jagged blade slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, wings folding
death.5: hits the ground: lying on its back along the ground, hooves toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, horns on the ground; the jagged black blade lies on the ground at the lower-right; the red bat wings spread flat under it, the tail limp
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the wings settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on its back, yellow eyes dark, the jagged blade on the ground beside it, the bat wings spread limp under it
